edition.description: Act and scene numbering of the Folger Shakespeare Library edition.

characters.name: Othello
characters.summary: A Moorish general in the service of Venice, renowned and respected.

notes.text: Is persuaded by Iago that Desdemona is unfaithful.
Smothers Desdemona, learns the truth, and takes his own life.

characters.name: Iago
characters.summary: Othello’s ensign, outwardly “honest”, inwardly full of resentment.

notes.text: Gets Cassio drunk and into a brawl that costs him his post.
Is exposed by his wife and taken prisoner.

characters.name: Desdemona
characters.summary: A Venetian senator’s daughter, spirited and devoted.

notes.text: Is killed by Othello in her bed.
Loses his rank after a drunken brawl.
Is wounded in a night ambush.

characters.name: Roderigo
characters.summary: A foolish Venetian gentleman in love with Desdemona.

notes.text: Finds Desdemona’s handkerchief and gives it to Iago.
Exposes Iago’s plot and is killed by him.

characters.name: The Duke of Venice
characters.summary: Ruler of Venice, anxious about the Turkish fleet.

characters.name: Bianca
characters.summary: A courtesan in Cyprus, in love with Cassio.

characters.name: Lodovico
characters.summary: A Venetian nobleman, Desdemona’s kinsman, sent with letters from the Senate.

phases.label: Eloped & married
phases.note: They have married in secret.

phases.label: Publicly struck
phases.note: He strikes her before Lodovico.

phases.label: Kills her
phases.note: He smothers her, then learns she was true.

phases.label: Ensign & general
phases.note: “I follow him to serve my turn upon him.”

phases.label: Poisons his mind
phases.note: Iago convinces him Desdemona loves Cassio.

phases.label: Exposed
phases.note: Othello wounds him; Iago refuses to explain.

phases.label: Puppet-master & dupe
phases.note: Iago takes his money, promising him Desdemona.

phases.label: Kills him
phases.note: Iago stabs him to silence him.

phases.label: Resentment
phases.note: Cassio was promoted over him.

phases.label: Married
phases.note: She gives him the handkerchief he wanted.

phases.label: Kills her
phases.note: He stabs her when she reveals the truth.

phases.label: Disowns her
phases.note: “She has deceived her father, and may thee.”

phases.label: Accuses him of witchcraft
phases.note: He claims Othello bewitched his daughter.

phases.label: Dismissed
phases.note: Othello strips him of his rank after the brawl.

phases.label: Successor
phases.note: Cassio is left to govern Cyprus.

phases.label: His advocate
phases.note: She pleads with Othello to reinstate him.

phases.label: Defends her honour
phases.note: She swears to Desdemona’s innocence at the cost of her life.

phases.label: Lovers
phases.note: He asks her to copy the embroidery on a handkerchief he found.

phases.label: Sends him to Cyprus
phases.note: Venice needs him against the Turks.

phases.label: Drunken brawl
phases.note: Cassio wounds him.

phases.label: Venetian envoy
phases.note: He witnesses Othello strike Desdemona.

phases.label: Brothers
phases.note: Gratiano reports that Brabantio died of grief at the marriage.
